chunks: Verily those who blaspheme unsuspecting chaste believing women will be cursed in this world and the next; and for them there will be severe punishment.

key_terms.الْمُحْصَنَاتِ: Chaste women (who are married or free from fornication)

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for falsely accusing chaste women of adultery in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the gravity of *al-ghaflah* (heedlessness) in chaste women, distinguishing them from those who might be more aware of their reputation, thereby emphasizing the vulnerability of the faithful to false accusations. The dual curse in both the dunya and akhirah underscores that the punishment begins with the social stigma and divine displeasure in this life, culminating in the severe *adhab* of the hereafter. This serves as a foundational text for the legal requirement of four eyewitnesses in *hadd* cases of adultery, protecting the honor of the *mu'minat*.
